# `x4similar`

```text
usage: x4similar [-h] [--version] [--reference REFERENCE] [--ext-dir EXT_DIR]
                 [--threshold THRESHOLD] [--cross-mod-only] [--candidate CANDIDATE]

Advisory fuzzy same-ship detection across base+DLC+installed mods.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --reference REFERENCE
                        unpacked base+DLC tree ($X4_REFERENCE)
  --ext-dir EXT_DIR     extensions dir (default: game-root from _registry)
  --threshold THRESHOLD
                        minimum similarity 0-1 to report (default 0.85)
  --cross-mod-only      only report pairs from DIFFERENT sources (skip a mod's own paint variants)
  --candidate CANDIDATE
                        restrict to pairs involving this mod folder
```
